conditional_source_lifting_theorem.statement: If a recognized rational target is independently mapped to source rational c1 coordinates q=(r,s), choose N>0 with (Nr,Ns) integral. The generated symbolic cocycle class (Nr,Ns) yields Cartier divisor D_N=(Nr)D_x∞+(Ns)D_y∞; (1/N)D_N has source rational c1 coordinates q.

cycle_class_correctness_scope: conditional source rational divisor/c1 lattice only; not a proof for arbitrary rational Hodge classes

explicit_control.denominator_independence: both give the same rational valuation vector (0,1/2,0,-1/3) modulo rational principal divisors

missing_Hodge_critical_map: arbitrary recognized rational (1,1) class -> source-generated rational c1/Picard coordinates without invoking classical Lefschetz (1,1) surjectivity

typing.rational_Hodge_class: C_H input; not identified with source Q^2 coordinates without a comparison map
typing.source_integral_class: integer pair (a,b) derived from generated Picard/c1 source
